camera.source: template match of a patch of sunlit ground (frame 13, x 180-300, y 200-280) in every frame, correlation 0.92 to 1.0; camera.json reads zero for frames 0 and 1 while the ground already moves 20 px, so the ground track is used instead

objects.why: no Quick, Draw! category is a ground line; this is the edge of the sunlit sand the flamingo stands on

notes.0: A second flamingo stands at the right edge; ours is still off frame to the left.
notes.2: The camera pans left fast; the tail of our flamingo comes in at the left edge.

notes.8: Our flamingo is fully in frame, standing on one leg with its head on its back.
notes.13: The pan stops; the flamingo stands still.
notes.16: The camera drifts back a little to the right.
notes.22: The bird settles a few pixels to the left on its leg.
notes.25: End: the flamingo still stands on one leg.
